scope.sqliteLogBrowserContract: Preserve SQL argument/result semantics but route the diagnostic to an internal no-op sink. Do not expose or invoke a host callback; sqlite3_log side effects are not part of the shipped browser/read-only API.

Macro semantics/flag token mapping are checked against exact pinned sqliteInt.h definition hashes; relevant func.c conditional membership is evaluated for captured compile options. This is not a general C preprocessor.
